unmapped_findings: Nominal composition of the Zr0 steel is Fe-25Mn-7Al-0.9C-0Zr (wt.%); it is the Zr-free reference alloy used as baseline in the paper.
Average O content 12–89 ppm, N ~18 ppm and H ~2 ppm in the steelmaking process for these Fe-Mn-Al-C low density steels.

The Zr0 steel exhibits a homogeneous grain structure after the TMT treatment (contrasting with the heterogeneous grain structure developed in the Zr0.50 steel); increasing Zr content increases the FG zone fraction (0 % for Zr0).
The Zr0 steel's fracture surface consists mainly of small dimples and cleavage faces, in contrast to the larger, deeper and denser dimples of the higher-Zr steels.
